propositions: Link-sync tests currently exercise the relation vocabulary with a single representative (blocks ~19×, depends_on 0×), creating a test-gap class that allowed the c8ed outbound depends_on direction bug to ship.

The link-dedup and link-removal-sync test modules must be parametrized over the full relation vocabulary (mapped: blocks, depends_on, relates_to; unmapped: duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) to cover all code paths and prevent regressions.

The outbound _diff_links emission test must assert the correct (jira_type, swap) tuple for each mapped relation, with depends_on specifically asserting swap=True to guard against re-introduction of direction bugs.

The REMOVE path's untested inward/outward direction logic branch (outbound_links.py:193-202) must be covered by a test case where an outward Blocks link with a removed local depends_on dependency emits a remove mutation with the correct relation.
